name: Brookhaven 🏡RP
desc:
A place to play with like minded people and roleplay. Own and live in amazing houses, drive cool vehicles and explore the city. Be whoever you want to be in Brookhaven RP.

Latest Update:
🧘 New wellness estate and free house!
🌿 7 new props!
🥤 New smoothie tumbler tool!

Thanks for playing!

Private Server Benefits:
· Prop Saving
· Server-Wide Music
· Server-Wide Announcements
· Remove or Lock Props
· Check Prop Owners
· Set Players as Admins
· Kick / Temp Ban Players
· Set Day of the Week
· Set Time by the Hour
· Change Weather and Lighting
· Speed up Time
· Server Theme Controls
· No Wait Time for Changing House 
· Spawn Up to Three Vehicles
· Prop Limit Increased
· Freecam for PC users (Shift+P)

scripts.features:
✨ Ishaxann's Fonts – Brookhaven Font Changer

🎨 27 Unique Font Styles

· Each font has its own emoji prefix/suffix: 🕷️, 💎, ⚡, 🌸, ♬, ⚔, 💥, 🚀, 🎀, 🏴‍☠️, 🔥, ✨, ⚔️, 🧿, 👑, 🪧, 🦇, 🗿, 🗽, Ω, †, ♡, ♪, →, ☠, ツ
· Based on Unicode character maps (Cyrillic, Greek, Japanese, Square, SmallCaps, Thai, Bubbles, etc.)

🔄 Auto Font Cycling

· Toggle AUTO – ON to automatically cycle through all 27 fonts
· Adjustable cycle speed – click Speed: 1.0s to set custom delay

✏️ Manual Controls

· Change Font ↓ – manually cycle through all styles
· Custom Name Input – type any name and press Enter to apply
· HU YAAR Mode – append "HU YAAR" to your name with matching font style

🌈 RGB Color Cycling

· Toggle RGB – ON for rainbow color effect on your RP name and bio
· Works independently of AUTO mode

🖥️ Premium UI Features

· Smooth Drag System – glide animation while dragging
· Minimize/Expand – collapse menu to a small bar with smooth animation
· Dark Theme – clean, modern black interface with subtle transparency
· Purple Loading Screen – elegant loading screen with blur effect and progress bar
